heard: 21 soldiers faced 10,000 tribesmen alone. At 9am on September 12, 1897, the attack struck Saragari Outpost. Hovildar Ishar Singh commanded the small garrison, holding the heliograph mirror. Attackers created a thick smokescreen by setting fire to surrounding bushes. Seaport Gormuk Singh flashed real-time updates across the valley to Fort Lockhart. During the breach, the signaler asked permission to pack his equipment. All 21 defenders fell after fighting to the last man. 10,000 tribesmen surrounded 21 men who stood alone.
differences: '0 a m' heard as 'am' after 'alone at 9'
'sepoy gurmukh' heard as 'seaport gormuk' after 'to surrounding bushes'
